problem_statement: The puikinsh/Adminator-admin-dashboard 2026 shell ships a static row of dashboard KPI cards (Total visits, Page views, Unique visitors, Bounce rate) with no way for an operator to focus the grid on one metric family. Add a native 'KPI focus' filter to the dashboard widget zone: a segmented tab row (reusing the shell's own .tabs pills styling) with All metrics / Traffic / Engagement / Revenue, sitting above a six-card KPI grid. Picking a category must filter the cards to that family and re-sync a live 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout. Echo the same focus row onto the Charts and Forms surfaces so the metric-focus rhythm stays consistent across the workspace, without breaking the existing shell, sidebar, breadcrumbs, topbar controls, theme toggle, or mobile drawer.
required_content: Add a visible dashboard component labeled exactly KPI focus with a segmented tab row. Mount the whole feature inside a root container carrying the class kpifocus (the module's own BEM root, matching the kpifocus.js/_kpifocus.scss file names) so the region is scroll-addressable via .kpifocus.

The tab row must offer All metrics, Traffic, Engagement, and Revenue, reusing Adminator's own .tabs pills styling. Each tab is a button with the BEM element class kpifocus__tab and a data-kpi-tab attribute keyed all/traffic/engagement/revenue (e.g. class="kpifocus__tab" data-kpi-tab="traffic").
A six-card KPI grid must render below the tabs, each card carrying the BEM element class kpifocus__card and tagged with its metric family via data-kpi-cat (traffic/engagement/revenue).
A live readout element with the BEM element class kpifocus__readout must read 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' and default to 'Showing 6 of 6 · All metrics'.
Clicking a category tab must filter the KPI cards to that family AND re-sync the readout count and label to the selected category (e.g. Showing 2 of 6 · Traffic).
The KPI focus row must appear on the dashboard (index), the Charts route, and the Forms route so the focus rhythm is consistent across every workspace surface.
The tab row and card grid must wrap without horizontal overflow of the admin shell at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.

Keep the existing Adminator brand, sidebar navigation groups, active sidebar styling, breadcrumbs, search command button, notifications/messages/account dropdowns, theme toggle, chart panels, table, footer, and mobile drawer behavior intact.
design_constraints: Implement through the KPI focus module src/assets/scripts/2026/kpifocus.js and its stylesheet src/assets/styles/2026/_kpifocus.scss, wired from the shared 2026 entry.
Reuse Adminator's own .tabs pills tab styling and .kpi-card chrome; the focus row must read as part of the operational dashboard, not a bolted-on marketing rail.
The category filter must actually filter the KPI cards and the readout must be recomputed live on each click (no frozen/snapshotted count or label).
Do not add dependencies, routes, remote assets, generated images, or a new framework.
The KPI focus row must remain readable on desktop, tablet, and mobile without horizontal overflow, clipped values, overlapping cards, or dark-on-dark/near-white-on-near-white illegibility.
The focus row must not disable the existing theme toggle, dropdowns, sidebar group expand/collapse, or mobile drawer interactions.

Follow the module's BEM naming so the feature is state-addressable: root container class kpifocus, tab buttons class kpifocus__tab with data-kpi-tab (all/traffic/engagement/revenue), KPI cards class kpifocus__card with data-kpi-cat (traffic/engagement/revenue), and the live count element class kpifocus__readout. The same kpifocus root, tabs, cards, and readout are echoed on the Charts and Forms surfaces.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect the original Adminator shell (sidebar, topbar controls, hero, KPI cards, footer) and the new KPI focus row on the dashboard before any interaction.
desktop_kpi_focus scrolls the dashboard KPI focus row into view and verifies the default 'Showing 6 of 6 · All metrics' readout with the six tagged KPI cards rendered as a tidy grid.

desktop_kpi_traffic and desktop_kpi_revenue click the Traffic and Revenue tabs and require the readout to re-sync to the selected family (Showing 2 of 6 · Traffic / Revenue); a readout frozen on 'All metrics' is a failed interaction.
desktop_charts_route and desktop_forms_route verify the shared KPI focus rhythm is echoed onto the Charts and Forms surfaces so the focus workflow stays consistent across every workspace surface.
desktop_theme_toggle protects the existing dark-mode toggle after the change.
tablet_kpi_focus and mobile_kpi_focus require the KPI focus tab row and card grid to wrap without horizontal overflow of the admin shell at tablet and phone widths.
mobile_drawer_open opens the responsive sidebar drawer and protects the mobile navigation after the change.

change_completion: A KPI focus filter appears on the dashboard with a segmented All/Traffic/Engagement/Revenue tab row above a six-card KPI grid.
Clicking a category tab filters the cards to that family and the 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout re-syncs its count and label live.
design_consistency: The focus row reuses Adminator's existing .tabs pills, .kpi-card surfaces, borders, type scale, and color tokens.
The KPI focus rhythm is echoed consistently onto the Charts and Forms surfaces rather than living only on the dashboard.
responsive: The tab row and card grid wrap on tablet and mobile without horizontal overflow or clipped card values.
The mobile drawer still opens above content and the focus row does not block the topbar controls.
regression: Adminator brand, sidebar nav, KPI cards, chart panels, table, footer, and shell controls remain intact.
The existing theme toggle and mobile drawer actions still succeed under the capture protocol.
implementation_continuity: The change is centralized in the KPI focus module + stylesheet wired from the shared 2026 entry with no new dependency or framework migration.
The filter reuses the dashboard's own KPI card markup and tab styling rather than an external widget or backend service.

metadata.design_goal: preserve and evolve interactive state, filters, forms, dialogs, routes, or session-like UI state
metadata.source_repo_kind: Webpack static Adminator dashboard with shared 2026 shell renderer, body state attributes, theme persistence, and mobile drawer
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable dashboard/admin repo with a real shared shell state contract across many pages, making it a clean L2 cross-page state-continuity target.

author_notes: Slot slot_250 targets dashboard_admin / state_continuity / restyle / cross_page / L4. puikinsh/Adminator-admin-dashboard was selected because its vanilla-JS 2026 admin dashboard hosts a real KPI card widget zone plus ready .tabs/.tab pill machinery, and shares one shell (Shell.js sidebar/topbar) across the dashboard, charts, and forms pages, so a genre-native KPI focus filter (a metric-family segmented control over the dashboard's own KPI grid, echoed across surfaces) can be added without new dependencies, routes, remote assets, generated images, or a framework migration. The leg-varying surface is the KPI focus module (kpifocus.js) and its stylesheet (_kpifocus.scss); every screenshot, KPI card image, and SVG glyph is authored inline.
